questions.question: Asked whether only a few people would be saved, Jesus said to make every effort to enter through what?
Jesus warned that some people would be thrown out of God's kingdom. Who would they see inside it?

answers.text: Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets
Moses and Aaron and Miriam and all the priests
David and Solomon and Hezekiah and all the kings

questions.question: When Pharisees warned Jesus that Herod wanted to kill Him, what did Jesus say He would keep doing today and tomorrow?

answers.text: Driving out demons and healing people
Staying out of sight in the villages

questions.question: Jesus said He had often longed to gather the children of Jerusalem together. What did He compare it to?

answers.text: A hen gathering her chicks under her wings
A shepherd gathering his sheep into the fold
A fisherman gathering his nets into the boat
